title: Respect feature axes and training statistics
scope: Non-square array axes; provided training-only means

items.prompt: Training array shape is 2×3 (rows=samples, columns=features): [[1, 2, 10], [3, 4, 14]]. Compute its three column means. Do not reduce across the feature axis into two row means.
items.solution: Average the two entries in each column: [2, 3, 12]. Store training statistics; held-out data must not refit them.
hints: Identify the requested quantity and its units before calculating.
